scientific_limitations: The \(M^{-2}\) coefficient expansion is for fixed \(\beta\); the low-temperature law is a subsequent \(\beta\to\infty\) asymptotic.
The general \(z\) result is a theorem about the explicitly defined midpoint-covariance functional. Its interpretation as a physical entropy lower bound requires a model-specific derivation.
The result does not prove saturation of the source paper's lower bound at finite cell count, and the necessary cell-count scale is not sufficient for a preparation-error guarantee.
title: Critical scaling of the finite-cell covariance lower-bound coefficient
